settingsAiBehavior.title: AI Behavior
settingsAiBehavior.description: Customize how the AI processes and responds to your tickets by providing context and custom instructions.
settingsAiBehavior.configuredBanner: AI behavior is customized for your tenant
settingsAiBehavior.notConfiguredBanner: Using default AI behavior — configure below to tailor the AI to your product
settingsAiBehavior.productDescriptionHelper: Describe your product/service. This context is injected into all AI prompts to help the AI understand your domain.
settingsAiBehavior.productDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g., We are a SaaS billing platform for B2B companies...
settingsAiBehavior.responseLanguageHelper: Language used by the AI in generated responses. Leave on auto-detect to match the ticket language.
settingsAiBehavior.globalInstructionsHelper: Custom instructions applied to ALL AI features (triage, analysis, N1 support).
settingsAiBehavior.globalInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g., Focus on security vulnerabilities. Our critical components are: auth, billing, webhooks.
settingsAiBehavior.triageInstructionsHelper: Custom instructions for ticket classification and severity assessment.
settingsAiBehavior.triageInstructionsPlaceholder:
e.g.,
- Our product is a REST API for inventory management
- 404 errors on /api/v1/* are usually incorrect IDs, not bugs
- Timeouts > 30s are severity critical (our SLA is 5s)
- CORS errors usually come from client-side misconfiguration
settingsAiBehavior.n1InstructionsHelper: Custom instructions for the N1 pre-triage assessment. Guide how the AI decides whether to resolve, mark as duplicate, or escalate tickets.
settingsAiBehavior.n1InstructionsPlaceholder:
e.g.,
- Tickets mentioning "legacy" or "/v1/" concern the old API, prefer no_fix_needed if a /v2/ equivalent exists
- Never mark as duplicate if app versions differ
- SSO-related errors must always escalate to N2 (security impact)
settingsAiBehavior.analysisInstructionsHelper: Custom instructions for deep code analysis and bug investigation.
settingsAiBehavior.analysisInstructionsPlaceholder:
e.g.,
- Our code convention: NestJS modules in src/modules/{domain}/
- Tests are in test/unit/ and test/e2e/
- Never modify files in src/core/ without human escalation
- Main branch is main, create fix branches from main
settingsAiBehavior.loadTemplateConfirm: This will replace your current instructions. Continue?

settingsAiBehavior.saveError: Failed to save AI behavior configuration
settingsAiBehavior.notConfiguredDetail: AI will use default behavior until you save at least a product description.
settingsAiBehavior.permissionError: Only owners and admins can modify AI behavior settings.
settingsAiBehavior.pipelineFeaturesDescription: Enable or disable individual stages of the AI processing pipeline. Disabled stages are skipped and tickets proceed to manual review.
settingsAiBehavior.enableTriageDescription: AI classifies tickets as bug/feature/question and assigns severity
settingsAiBehavior.enableN1Description: AI evaluates if a bug needs deep investigation or can be resolved directly
settingsAiBehavior.enableN2Description: AI agent investigates source code and proposes fixes
